Principal – Architecture & Development
Miami, FL | $200,000 Base + Equity Partnership + Aggressive Commissions
A forward-thinking architecture and development platform is seeking a highly accomplished Managing Principal to accelerate its growth and market presence throughout Miami and South Florida.
This opportunity is designed for an influential architectural leader with an established reputation among prominent residential and mixed-use developers, an exceptional portfolio of significant projects, and a demonstrated ability to consistently convert relationships into major commissions.
We are seeking more than an accomplished designer or practice leader. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor to developers—someone who understands the commercial realities of real estate development, recognizes opportunities early, and brings the relationships, credibility, and strategic judgment necessary to secure and deliver complex projects.
Combining architectural expertise with emerging AI-driven technology, the platform offers an opportunity to approach development with greater intelligence, efficiency, and commercial insight.
Position Overview
The Managing Principal will serve as a senior market leader, responsible for cultivating high-value client relationships, originating significant architectural commissions, and strengthening the firm's position within South Florida's competitive development community.
This individual will have substantial autonomy to shape business strategy, influence project pursuits, and drive long-term regional growth.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute a business growth strategy focused on multifamily residential and mixed-use developments throughout Miami and South Florida.
Leverage established relationships with developers, investors, and ownership groups to identify and secure substantial new commissions.
Serve as a trusted architectural and development advisor to senior-level clients throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead executive presentations, strategic negotiations, and high-profile project pursuits.
Provide overarching architectural and commercial leadership, ensuring design excellence aligns with development objectives.
Identify opportunities where AI-enabled technology can create measurable value for developers and project stakeholders.
Expand the firm's influence, market share, and long-term client relationships across the region.
Required Experience & Qualifications
Minimum 15 years of architectural experience, with significant experience in a Principal, Partner, or comparable senior leadership capacity.
Must be currently based in Miami or South Florida, with an established and active network of developer relationships.
Extensive portfolio of major residential, multifamily, and mixed-use developments.
Proven history of personally originating business and securing substantial architectural commissions.
Strong relationships with prominent developers, real estate investors, and ownership groups.
Sophisticated understanding of the entire development process, from initial feasibility and project economics through entitlement, design, and delivery.
Exceptional executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Commercially astute, highly ambitious, and capable of translating market relationships into sustained business growth.
Understanding of AI's emerging applications and potential impact on architecture and the real estate development industry.
Compensation & Partnership
$200,000 Base Salary + Equity Partnership Opportunity + Highly Aggressive Commission Structure
The compensation structure is designed to reward exceptional business generation, with substantial upside tied directly to new commissions secured and the long-term growth of the practice.
This is an opportunity for a proven industry leader to move beyond the limitations of a conventional Principal position and participate in the financial success of the business they help develop.
Miami / South Florida candidates only.
If interested in discussing further, please apply directly to Dan Cloke at [email protected].
